spec.title: GenAI
spec.description: Model calls, token usage, tool executions, and traces of AI applications, following the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions.

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: Application instances, from the most recently started.

spec.title: Model Calls
spec.description: Calls to chat and embedding models in the selected time range.

spec.title: Failed Calls
spec.description: Calls to models that failed in the selected time range.

spec.title: Average Duration
spec.description: Average duration of the calls to models in the selected time range.

spec.title: Input Tokens
spec.description: Tokens sent to models in the selected time range, as reported by the providers.

spec.title: Output Tokens
spec.description: Tokens generated by models in the selected time range, as reported by the providers.

spec.title: Tool Calls
spec.description: Tools executed on behalf of models in the selected time range.

spec.title: Calls
spec.description: Calls per second, by operation and model.

spec.title: Failures
spec.description: Failed calls per second, by error type and model.

spec.title: Duration
spec.description: Average and longest call, by model. For chat models, it's the time to the complete response.

spec.expr: sum by (model) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "model", "$1", "gen_ai_request_model", "(.+)"), "model", "$1", "gen_ai_response_model", "(.+)")) / sum by (model) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "model", "$1", "gen_ai_request_model", "(.+)"), "model", "$1", "gen_ai_response_model", "(.+)"))

spec.title: Token Usage
spec.description: Tokens per second sent to models (input) and generated by them (output).

spec.title: Tokens by Model
spec.description: Tokens in the selected time range, by model and type.

spec.title: Tokens per Call
spec.description: Average and largest number of tokens in a call, by model and type. Large inputs often come from long conversations or many tool definitions.

spec.expr: sum by (gen_ai_response_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_response_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_count{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Tool Calls
spec.description: Tool executions per second, by tool, and the failed ones.

spec.title: Tool Duration
spec.description: Average and longest tool execution, by tool.

spec.expr: sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (rate(spring_ai_tool_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_tool_name) (rate(spring_ai_tool_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: ChatClient Duration
spec.description: Average and longest ChatClient request, end to end: advisors, model calls, and tool executions included.

spec.title: Model Calls
spec.description: The most recent calls to models. Select a trace to see its spans, with the captured content when enabled.

spec.query: {resource.service.name="$job" && resource.service.instance.id="$instance" && span.gen_ai.operation.name=~"chat|embeddings"} | select(span.gen_ai.request.model, span.gen_ai.response.model, span.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, span.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, span.gen_ai.response.finish_reasons)
